inspectedClaims: The implementation keeps visual approval, technical QA and release approval as separate records and states.
New pipeline-managed production items require a human release record bound to the testing item digest and QA report digest.

The asset lab calls its action technical QA and explicitly says a separate decision-maker approval is required.
The repository entrypoint, runbook, policy and status command establish one recovery mechanism rather than parallel instructions.
The policy and contract verifier keep external deployment prohibited; no external publication was executed.
The capability truth remains constrained_real and does not claim that arbitrary reference screenshots can automatically become visually acceptable mockups.
openAcceptanceWork: Run one real new mockup from user-provided reference through visual decision, technical QA, release decision and local production promotion.
Observe recovery in a separate new conversation without old chat context.
Obtain human acceptance of the complete final acceptance fingerprint.
